Specification: This specification is a small test module that exercises priming behavior and operator arguments in TLA+. It defines two state variables, x and y, initializes x as a function over the set {1,2}, and then defines a Next action with two non-stuttering branches plus a stuttering branch. The purpose of the test is to distinguish how priming behaves when action operators are called with variables as arguments, specifically comparing an operator that uses d' inside an EXCEPT update with one that uses d unprimed, and checking the resulting next-state value with TLC Print and Assert calls.
IfThenElse: IF x[1]' = 2 THEN Print("Test1 OK", TRUE) ELSE Assert(FALSE, "Test1 Failed")
IF x[1]' = 1 THEN Print("Test2 OK", TRUE) ELSE Assert(FALSE, "Test2 Failed")
